req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with the same body for the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: The idempotency requirement for PUT /tasks/{task_id} means that issuing the same PUT request N times must yield the same terminal state as issuing it once. Tests must: (1) confirm a repeated PUT returns 200 with identical payload both times (positive/EP), (2) confirm PUT on a non-existent task_id returns 404 consistently on every call (negative/NEG), (3) confirm idempotency at the boundary where all optional fields are supplied vs. only one field (BVA), (4) confirm state-transition idempotency by reading back via GET after two PUTs (STC), and (5) confirm that a PUT with a minimal single-field body is idempotent (DT). Assertions use exact values to catch operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_full_body_positive
preconditions: A task is created via POST to obtain a valid task_id
actions: PUT /tasks/{task_id} with full body {title, description, completed}
Assert both responses are 200 and payloads are equal

import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

from app.database import get_db
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_idempotent_full_body_positive():
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Original', 'description': 'desc', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()['id']
    body = {'title': 'Updated Title', 'description': 'Updated desc', 'completed': True}
    r1 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=body)
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    j1 = r1.json()
    assert j1['id'] == task_id
    assert j1['title'] == 'Updated Title'
    assert j1['description'] == 'Updated desc'
    assert j1['completed'] == True
    r2 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=body)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    j2 = r2.json()
    assert j2['id'] == j1['id']
    assert j2['title'] == j1['title']
    assert j2['description'] == j1['description']
    assert j2['completed'] == j1['completed']

test_put_idempotent_full_body_positive()

os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db

def test_put_idempotent_state_verified_by_get():
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Init', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()['id']
    body = {'title': 'Final State', 'completed': True}
    r1 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=body)

    jg = rg.json()
    assert jg['id'] == task_id
    assert jg['title'] == 'Final State'
    assert jg['completed'] == True

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_idempotent_decision_table_completed_toggle():
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Toggle Task', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()['id']
    for _ in range(3):
        rv = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Toggle Task', 'completed': True})
        assert rv.status_code == 200
        assert rv.json()['completed'] == True
        assert rv.json()['title'] == 'Toggle Task'
        assert rv.json()['id'] == task_id
    for _ in range(3):
        rv = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Toggle Task', 'completed': False})
        assert rv.status_code == 200
        assert rv.json()['completed'] == False
        assert rv.json()['title'] == 'Toggle Task'
        assert rv.json()['id'] == task_id

test_put_idempotent_decision_table_completed_toggle()

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_idempotent_boundary_max_title_length():
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Seed', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()['id']
    title_100 = 'T' * 100
    r1 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': title_100})
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.json()['title'] == title_100
    assert len(r1.json()['title']) == 100
    r2 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': title_100})
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()['title'] == title_100
    assert r1.json()['title'] == r2.json()['title']
    title_101 = 'T' * 101
    r3 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': title_101})
    assert r3.status_code == 422

test_put_idempotent_boundary_max_title_length()
